title: Community apps turn images into design mockups
summary:
Three community image apps landed, alongside a small readability pass on the Enter dashboard.

AdityaTel89 added Map to 3D Isometric Buildings, which turns map screenshots and a location description into downloadable isometric city artwork. Prateek Verma added AI Packaging Designer, which turns product photos into box, bottle, bag, or can mockups with preset or custom styling.

anmolsah added Virtual Makeup Studio for trying AI-generated looks on a selfie. It includes four style presets, custom prompts, a before-and-after slider, and downloads.

The dashboard now labels balances in pollen, renames the API key action to “Create new key,” and adjusts FAQ, table, and button styling for clearer visual hierarchy.

highlights.title: Maps become isometric cities
highlights.text: Upload or paste a map screenshot, describe the location, and make downloadable isometric city artwork.

highlights.title: Product photos become packaging
highlights.text: Turn a product photo into a box, bottle, bag, or can mockup. Choose a style or write your own description.

highlights.title: Try on AI makeup
highlights.text: Apply a preset or custom makeup look to a selfie, compare it with the original, and download the result.
